title: GuildWar QoL
description: This 1.21.10 QoL pack for GuildWar.eu boosts performance with Sodium and optimizes armor displays beyond 30 points. A smart chat filter prevents spam and notifies you of pings, all easily configurable via the in-game menu.
body:
The official Quality-of-Life modpack for **GuildWar.eu** (_Minecraft 1.21.10_). This version introduces massive technical upgrades and social features to make your time on the server even more immersive and efficient.

## 🚀 Extreme Performance & Visuals
- **Distant Horizons:** Experience breathtaking views with significantly increased level-of-detail (LOD) rendering distance without killing your FPS.
- **Sodium (0.7+) & Iris:** The latest rendering engine for peak performance and high-end shader support.
- **Entity Culling & Dynamic FPS:** Smart resource management that only renders what you see and saves power when tabbed out.
- **3D Skin Layers:** Adds depth to player skins for a more detailed look.

## 🛡️ Competitive Edge & Interface
- **Overflowing Bars & AttributeFix:** Vital for GuildWar! Correctly displays massive armor and health values beyond vanilla limits.
- **AppleSkin:** Essential for survival—visualizes hunger and saturation.
- **ItemLocks:** Protect your precious gear by locking items in your inventory to prevent accidental dropping or moving.
- **Better Ping Display:** Real-time numerical ping in the tab list for precise connection monitoring.
- **Great Scrollable Tooltips:** Easily read long item descriptions and enchantments.

## 💬 Enhanced Social & Chat
- **Essential Mod:** Connect with friends, take high-quality screenshots, and use a variety of social features directly in-game.
- **Chat Heads & Smooth Chat:** See player faces next to their messages and enjoy fluid, animated chat transitions.
- **Compact Chat & Chat Notify:** Keeps your chat clean from spam and ensures you never miss a ping when someone mentions you.

## ⚙️ Utility & Comfort
- **In-Game Account Switcher:** Swap your profiles instantly without restarting the client.
- **Borderless Fullscreen:** Switch between your browser and Minecraft seamlessly.
- **Gamma Utils (Fullbright):** One-tap brightness adjustment for dark caves.
- **Resourcify:** Browse and download resource packs and shaders directly from the in-game menu.
- **OrthoCamera:** Allows for unique isometric perspectives—great for screenshots of your guild's base.
